CAF.note: Says only that domestic fibre coverage is limited; no backbone built, in service or reaching regions is stated.

facts.fact: Ecofin Agency says landlocked Central African Republic is now connected to Cameroon and Congo through the Central African Backbone project, and that access to submarine cables through neighbours has improved speeds; a South Sudan link is only planned.

Ecofin Agency says Central African Republic is now connected to Cameroon and Congo through the Central African Backbone project, which links ECCAS member states and is financed by the African Development Bank and the European Union.
